steps: Devein and butterfly the prawns (or ask your fishmonger to).
Melt the butter in an extra-large pan, sauté the garlic briefly, then the prawns, then pour in the lemon juice.
When the prawns are just turning pink, add the peanut butter and stir to dissolve.
Pour in the peri-peri sauce and coconut milk, bring to a simmer and season.
Serve with fresh crispy Portuguese rolls to scoop up the sauce.

resolvedChecks.note: The garlic is listed but not used in the method; adding it with the butter is the obvious place.
resolvedChecks.resolution: Garlic goes in with the butter.
